options.name: Order of the Warrior
options.benefit: Follow bushido; gain damage reduction against challenged foes, Knowledge expertise, Honour in All Things at 2nd level, Way of the Samurai at 8th, and Strike True at 15th.

options.name: Ronin
options.benefit: Follow a personal code; gain challenge and AC bonuses against creatures that mark you, Self Reliant at 2nd level, Without Master at 8th, and Chosen Destiny at 15th.
